claim: Septic shock is characterized by an excessive inflammatory response depicted in a cytokine storm that results from invasive bacterial, fungi, protozoa, and viral infections.
source: Septic shock is characterized by an excessive inflammatory response depicted in a cytokine storm that results from invasive bacterial, fungi, protozoa, and viral infections.
evidence: This is a definitional statement about septic shock that draws from established scientific understanding of the condition.

claim: Non-canonical inflammasome activation is crucial in the development of septic shock promoting pyroptosis and proinflammatory cytokine production via caspase-11 and gasdermin D (GSDMD).
source: Non-canonical inflammasome activation is crucial in the development of septic shock promoting pyroptosis and proinflammatory cytokine production via caspase-11 and gasdermin D (GSDMD).
evidence: This statement is supported by established scientific knowledge about inflammasome pathways in septic shock.

claim: NAD+ treatment protected mice toward bacterial and lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced endotoxic shock by blocking the non-canonical inflammasome specifically.
source: Here, we show that NAD+ treatment protected mice toward bacterial and lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced endotoxic shock by blocking the non-canonical inflammasome specifically.
evidence: This claim is supported by experimental data presented in the manuscript showing survival outcomes and mechanistic studies.

claim: NAD+ administration impeded systemic IL-1β and IL-18 production and GSDMD-mediated pyroptosis of macrophages via the IFN-β/STAT-1 signaling machinery.
source: NAD+ administration impeded systemic IL-1β and IL-18 production and GSDMD-mediated pyroptosis of macrophages via the IFN-β/STAT-1 signaling machinery.
evidence: This is supported by experimental data including ELISA measurements, western blots, and RNA-sequencing results presented in the manuscript.

claim: NAD+ administration not only improved casp-11 KO (knockout) survival but rendered wild type (WT) mice completely resistant to septic shock via the IL-10 signaling pathway that was independent from the non-canonical inflammasome.
source: More importantly, NAD+ administration not only improved casp-11 KO (knockout) survival but rendered wild type (WT) mice completely resistant to septic shock via the IL-10 signaling pathway that was independent from the non-canonical inflammasome.
evidence: This is supported by survival experiments with casp-11 KO mice and IL-10-/- mice presented in the manuscript.

claim: Sepsis is characterized by a systemic inflammatory response syndrome (Kaukonen et al., 2015) driven by host cells following systemic bacterial (Ramachandran, 2014) and viral infections.
source: Sepsis is characterized by a systemic inflammatory response syndrome (Kaukonen et al., 2015) driven by host cells following systemic bacterial (Ramachandran, 2014) and viral infections.
evidence: This statement is supported by citations to previous literature.

claim: The excessive inflammatory response can derail into septic shock resulting in multiple organ failure, the leading cause of death in intensive care units.
source: The excessive inflammatory response can derail into septic shock resulting in multiple organ failure, the leading cause of death in intensive care units.
evidence: This is established medical knowledge about septic shock outcomes.

claim: Inflammasome activation has been pointed out as the major driver of septic shock.
source: Inflammasome activation, which downstream pathways cause the release of proinflammatory cytokines and the induction of an inflammatory cell death termed pyroptosis (Kumar, 2018), has been pointed out as the major driver of septic shock.
evidence: This is supported by citation to Kumar, 2018.

claim: Inflammasome activation causes the release of proinflammatory cytokines and the induction of an inflammatory cell death termed pyroptosis (Kumar, 2018).
